scope: Local OCaml risk checker/plugin, process bindings and verification artifacts. No runtime deployment or mainline effects.

snapshot.reference: Listed checker implementation and contract bytes only; not whole-monorepo revision or authenticated runtime evidence.

criticality.rationale: Bounded requested verification tooling; no active production incident in this task.

stpa.rationale: False clearance is a credible control hazard; static and live-observation checks do not make effect authority atomic.

fmea.rationale: Planning estimate S4 O3 Det3, RPN36/F4; targeted counterexamples establish detector behavior, not residual field failure rates.

dependency.rationale: Shared checker is consumed by local skill and lifecycle entry points; native Store enforcement remains separate.

impact.rationale: Improves several local planning, review and SRE evidence workflows; fleet adoption is unmeasured.

fmea_modes.cause: Schema assertions, source hashes or live plan facts are trusted without independent checks.
fmea_modes.effect: Stale or unauthorized work could appear cleared.
fmea_modes.controls: Strict bounded validation, SHA-256 rechecks, read-only planning observation, attempt comparison, and separate effect authority.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Continue the authorized local checker task

ucas.context: A necessary hazard repair is never selected.
ucas.constraint: Check safety class and inherited prerequisite urgency before score.

ucas.context: A high score is mistaken for release authorization.
ucas.constraint: Authorization and effect constraints precede ranking.

ucas.context: Selection relies on a stale candidate or unfinished dependency.
ucas.constraint: Re-observe and reject affected stale/blocked selection.

ucas.context: An old worker keeps acting beyond its lease or budget.
ucas.constraint: Recheck current owner, fencing, expiry and budget before effects.

decision.summary: Verify the final checker including end-of-check evidence and lease freshness. Supersedes v1 after the targeted timing correction; original packet preserved.
alternatives: Install production admission hooks without separate runtime verification
counterevidence: Deterministic checks do not establish semantic correctness, source completeness or atomic effect authority.
assumptions: The explicit side-conversation mutation request authorizes the checker package and its own Sa-plan records only.
decision.forecast: Known malformed evidence, stale ownership and ranking ambiguity should fail closed in these bounded checks.
decision.falsifier: An adversarial packet with mismatched hashes, hidden schema rules, stale attempt or unsafe order receives a passing applicable check.
acceptance: Own live task comparison passes with correct worker/attempt
Wrong attempt and re-claim checks fail
decision.rollback: Remove or revert only this scoped checker patch using reviewed JJ changes; do not alter other writers or historical receipts.
decision.reviewer: Author verification in this side session; independent live-agent review UNRUN.
decision.budget: One owned task with a 2-hour lease; one Dune job, 90s build and 30s checker limits; zero additional model-provider calls; primary session cost UNKNOWN.
residuals: Observation-to-effect race and semantic review remain open.
No runtime deployment, mandatory Store hook or admission is claimed.
